result_summary: Killed at the gate. summary.cost_bands['>0.6'] is zero on all 5 fully-matched pairs (gold vs gold-2, v1 vs v2, werg-a/b/c against their back-translations): 0 of 61 statements exceed the shipped 0.6 cut, the pooled matched cheapest-row cost tops out at 0.3477, and the file reading the CLI uses is zero as well, so no_counterpart never over-fires on construction-guaranteed matched content and no deletion fixture was built. The prediction is falsified in its own direction, matched p90 measuring 0.2496 against a predicted 0.45-0.55. The registered by-product widens the reading: over 55 ibm summary pairs (579 statements) the cheapest-row cost maximum is 0.5774 with p99 0.5707, so the +/-0.15 sweep flags 0 statements at 0.60 through 0.75, 12 (2.07%) at 0.55, 27 (4.66%) at 0.50 and 76 (13.13%) at 0.45 - the cut sits 0.023 above the largest cost this corpus produces and the flag is inert here rather than over-firing. Guardrails hold: V 0/24 at separation +0.0666, smd and order_gap bit-identical under cuts patched to 0.45, 0.70 and 0.75 on both the semantic and the structural detail JSON, triangle inequality 0 violations in 495 checks.
caveats: Three limits on the reading. First, the kill-gate list 'werg-a/b/c' names no partner, and it was read as the three back-translation pairs (werg-a vs werg-a~bt and so on), because the wergeland documents are separate sections of one article and cross-pairing them would not be fully matched; the two named A/B pairs were additionally read through the file path to remove the fixture-text-versus-file question, and both readings are zero. Second, the gate closes the over-firing question only: no true-removed population was scored, so the density valley between the matched and removed modes stays unlocated and nothing here says where between the observed 0.5774 maximum and the DEF-TRANS-1 field absorber at 0.76 the boundary belongs; NO_COUNTERPART_COST stays at 0.6 and its exact placement is deferred, not answered. Third, the field anchors quoted (synthetic removal at 1.414, field absorber 0.76 at weight 0.95, copy-edit cost median 0.096) were re-derived from docs/defects-docdistance.md, the corrected recount, because the corrections.json forensics archive the record names is not present in this repository.
